summary: Improve donor project budgeting, financial controls and audit preparation with practical Excel exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Financial management, budgeting and auditing of donor-funded projects connect approved budgets with traceable transactions and reliable reporting. For project finance staff, grant managers and internal auditors, the course develops practical skills in mapping budget lines to activities, tracking commitments and explaining variances in Excel. You also practise reconciling cash and ledger balances, testing payment support and assembling indexed evidence for audit review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, record, review or report project funds under donor agreements. It suits intermediate learners who work with project budgets, payment records or financial assurance and need stronger control over the supporting evidence.
modules: Excel Budget Baselines and Variance Analysis
COSO Transaction Controls and Payment Testing
Procurement Files and ISA Audit Evidence
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project budgets, accounting records or financial reporting is expected. Familiarity with donor-funded project transactions is useful. No coding or programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based analysis.
topics: Financial management for NGOs & donor-funded projects
